findings.what: The words explain the doubling through the angles of incidence and reflection each changing by 10°, but the picture draws no normal and no angle labels, so it shows the result (mirror 10°, beam 20°) and not the cause; draw the normal turning with the mirror and both angles going from 30° to 40°.

"The angles are equal, so every traced-back ray from one point meets at one spot" skips the step that makes it true, which the explanation has: each traced-back line is the arriving ray flipped across the mirror, so all of them pass through the lamp's flipped point.
